maya: quick note from marlin-48k bring-up: enabling 'doc-digest' compression causes a deterministic loss of grounding starting near token ~32,000. Repro and short logs below.

maya: repro cmd: `RUNTIME=dev ./onboard.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --ctx 48k --priming doc-digest --quant int3 --seed 7`

jordan: can you paste a tiny prompt + one line good vs bad output?

maya: prompt: system='You answer factual questions concisely.' + ~12k doc history + 3k eval Q.

maya: no-digest (40k): "Result: 7. Explanation ..."

maya: doc-digest (40k): "Not sure what you mean."

leo: do we have KV index counts and any pos_offset log?

maya: yes: kv_len=32008; compress logs show `pos_anchor = (orig_idx // stride) * stride` (commit 4d2a).

anya: floor-based anchoring again. That can bias position by up to stride/2 and shift RoPE phases for far tokens.

jordan: can we flip to nearest-anchor (round) quickly and compare attention mass for a token near the breakpoint? If attention restores, it's likely a phase anchoring bug.

ci-bot: job queued: marlin-digest-anchor-test (owner: jordan) -> https://ci.redwood/org/jobs/3180011122

leo: quick sanity logs: before compress layer9 head2 attn_sum=0.82 tokens 31996-32006; after compress attn_sum=0.09 tokens 31996-32006. Huge drop.

jordan: update: rounded-anchor run completed, layer9 head2 attn_sum=0.78 and eval cross-entropy dropped 3.8->2.0. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3180011122

anya: action items: (1) revert to nearest-anchor in doc-digest compress; (2) add unit test simulating random strides ensuring max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3; (3) run int3/int4 quantized variants with --quant-skip-reshape to ensure quant path doesn't amplify drift.

maya: I'll file a ticket and attach logs. jordan, can you add a short note to the model onboarding checklist recommending doc-digest be disabled by default for ctx >=48k until validated?

jordan: will do. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: job finished: marlin-digest-anchor-test (status: success).
